author: reek
body: A texture array: one procedural texture per layer, shown as a 3x2 grid of panels that cycle through the array. Each pixel picks its panel (which layer) and its local coordinate, then a per-layer procedural pattern (checker, stripes, dots, rings, weave, gradient) is evaluated. The layer offset scrolls with the frame so the panels advance through the array. Reference site's "texture array" technique. Float math from DeviceMath.
